name: Natsuiro Kokoro Log
source:
One day, Yoshito was challenged by his senpai Kisara to a match in a fighting game. Even though he was confident in his skills, she was a top ranker and beat him handily. As a result, he had to join the cyber-research club that she was the leader of. It was a relatively new club, but it soon became lively with the addition of his osananajimi and student council deputy leader Kuon, his dependable imouto Rin and classmate Kotone.

At the start of summer vacation, Yoshito was asked by the club’s advisor Kanae to help test out a love simulation game that’s in development. However, all the female avatars in the game were played by the girls in the cyber-research club! Once it was revealed that his avatar had an AI which mimicked his personality, they interacted with him in ways that they normally wouldn’t in real life. Traversing the line between reality and imagination, he could see the true feelings of the heroines who are not honest with their feelings. Their summer love story begins now.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/05/01/may-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
某天，佳人被学姐如月挑战进行格斗游戏对决。尽管他对自己的技术很有信心，如月却是顶尖玩家，轻松击败了他。结果，他不得不加入这个由如月领导的网络研究部。

这是一个相对较新的社团，但随着他的青梅竹马兼学生会副会长久远、可靠的妹妹凛，以及同班同学琴音加入，社团很快热闹起来。

暑假开始时，社团顾问加奈江请佳人帮忙测试一款正在开发的恋爱模拟游戏。然而，游戏中的所有女性头像，扮演者竟然都是网络研究部的女孩们！当大家发现佳人的头像拥有能够模仿他性格的人工智能后，她们便以现实中不会采取的方式与他互动。在现实与幻想的界线之间穿行，他得以看见那些不善表达的女主角们的真实心意。他们的夏日恋爱故事就此开始。

[来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/05/01/may-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
